```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT) # For interactive tables
install.packages("ComplexUpset") # to make an upset plot
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r readfiles}
# 1. Identify all .tabular files in ~/galaxy_inputs/
file_paths <- list.files(
  path = "~/galaxy_inputs/upgenes_disease_mirna_matrix", 
  pattern = "\\.(tabular|txt)$", 
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Print found files to confirm
print(file_paths)


# Read and combine all detected files
combined_data <- file_paths %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_tsv(.x, col_names = c("disease", "mirna"),skip=1, col_types = cols())) %>%
  distinct(mirna, disease) %>%
  mutate(present = 1)

#check
dim(combined_data)
print(combined_data, n=42)
```

```{r make matrix}
mirna_disease_matrix <- combined_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = disease,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  # Count TRUE values across all disease columns (excluding the 'miRNA' column)
  # and sort descending so rows with the most TRUEs are at the top
  mutate(total_diseases = rowSums(across(-mirna))) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_diseases)) %>%
  select(-total_diseases) # Clean up the temporary count column

# Save the final matrix to a file
write_tsv(mirna_disease_matrix, "~/galaxy_inputs/upgenes_disease_mirna_matrix/upgenes_mirna_disease_matrix.tsv")
```

```{r interactive table, include=FALSE}
datatable(
  mirna_disease_matrix,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    dom = 'Bfrtip'
  ),
  filter = 'top',
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = 'Table 1: miRNA and Disease presence (1) / absence (0) matrix.'
)
```

```{r upset-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
library(ComplexUpset)

# Get all disease column names (excluding the 'miRNA' column)
disease_cols <- setdiff(colnames(mirna_disease_matrix), "miRNA")

# 1. Create and store the plot in a variable
p <- upset(
  data = mirna_disease_matrix,
  intersect = disease_cols,
  name = "Disease interactions for upregulated genes",
  min_size = 1,
  width_ratio = 0.2,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(
      counts = TRUE,
      text = list(size = 4.5),
      mapping = aes(fill = 'count')
    )
  ),
themes = upset_modify_themes(
    list(
      'intersections_matrix' = theme(
        text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Disease names on y-axis
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold") # "Disease interactions..." title
      ),
      'overall_sizes' = theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12) # "Set size" title
      ),
      'Intersection size' = theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold") # "Intersection size" label
      )
    )
  )
)

# 2. Display the plot (needed for R Markdown preview)
print(p)

# 3. Save as PDF
ggsave(
  filename = "~/galaxy_inputs/upgenes_disease_mirna_matrix/upset_plot_upregulated.pdf", 
  plot = p, 
  width = 10,      # Width in inches
  height = 6,      # Height in inches
  device = "pdf"
)

```
